method: AI-assisted source-by-source review; same agent, not blinded or independent

baselineEvaluation.note: Descriptive agreement with dependent AI reference labels, not validated accuracy. The Wilson interval only illustrates small-n uncertainty; purposive sampling and shared errors invalidate population inference. Unresolved and unchecked accepted records are reported separately, not counted as correct.

metricNote: Same-agent purposive source review, without independent reference labels. Review coverage and corrections are measured; accuracy and market recall are not.
